mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.1% over the past 3 months compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.1% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 6.5% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger risk-off sentiment, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 6.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and new housing starts (HOUST) indicates weakening consumer and housing demand, which together predict negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of RSAFS decline and HOUST decline fails to predict negative returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of rising industrial production (INDPRO > 100.5) and stable manufacturing capacity utilization, supply-side expansion supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 100.5 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 0.05% in a 3-month window, it signals aggressive monetary easing that boosts risk appetite, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.05% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicates labor market contraction, which together predict negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS decline and UNRATE rise fails to predict negative returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of rising consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL > 235.0) and strong retail sales (RSAFS > 420000), demand-side strength supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 235.0 and RSAFS > 420000 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 100.0 indicates robust supply-side expansion, which supports corporate output and profits, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 100.0 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).
